item: the damage-record tests wait for the record thread instead of leaning on note()'s two-second join
summary: Core-only on #1688 failed test_an_incident_of_another_process_is_its_own_record_even_when_no_session_id_is_known with assert 0 == 1. note() joins its record thread for at most RECORD_WAIT_S (2.0 s) and state(detail=True)['incidents'] never waits, so a test reading the record straight after its notes passed only if the thread finished in two seconds. Reproduced at the mechanism with a plugin that slows _record_new to 0.3 s and the wait to 0.01 s (27 of 107 failed, the CI assertion verbatim). Test-only: _settle(reg) before the first record read in 19 tests (22 insertions) and the registry fixture settles on teardown, since the process-global registry let a leftover record thread write 5 extra incidents into the next test. 107 pass unstalled, stalled and on SQLite 3.45.1; three mutants killed. Limits: the CI trigger (a stall of over 2 s of the record thread) is inferred and the Core-only order was not reproduced.
